d:
A woman in Begusarai, Bihar, was allegedly gang-raped by five men in June 2026. She approached the police, filed an FIR and underwent medical treatment. But her ordeal did not end there.
Her family alleges that they were repeatedly threatened and pressured to withdraw the case. They also claim that the police failed to act on several complaints. On November 9, the survivor was allegedly attacked again and thrown off the roof of her own house, leaving her seriously injured.
